acceptance_tests: ERC run reports 0 errors versus the 10-error baseline, with every remaining warning justified in writing.
DRC run reports 0 errors versus the 5-error baseline, with every remaining warning justified in writing.
Netlist audit confirms zero floating pins: U1.3, U1.4, U1.5, U2.1, U2.2, U2.3, U2.4 are connected or explicitly no-connect, and VBUS has more than one node.
Power-up from a USB-C host measures 3.3 V +/-5% at U1.1 and U2.1 with total draw under 500 mA.
I2C bus scan detects exactly one device at the TMP102 strapped address and returns ambient readings within +/-1.0 C of a reference thermometer.
Fabrication output review confirms 2-layer stackup, board within 110 x 65 mm, and all features at or above 0.2 mm trace/clearance and 0.6/0.3 mm vias.
Manufacturability check against the generic_two_layer profile returns no violations and a complete release package (Gerbers, drills, BOM, centroid).
constraints: Connector mismatch: the request specifies USB-C, but J1 is instantiated as Connector:USB_B_Micro with only VBUS/D+/D-/GND. A USB-C receptacle with CC pulldowns must replace it, or the request must be amended to micro-B.
No 3.3 V source exists: VBUS is a single-node net (J1.1) and +3V3 has no regulator or supply, so the board cannot currently power up.
TMP102 is entirely unpowered and unconnected except ADD0 to GND; VCC, GND, SDA, SCL are all floating.
No I2C nets exist; GPIO21/GPIO22 and U2.SDA/U2.SCL are unrouted.
ESP32 EN is tied directly to +3V3 with no RC reset network.
USB data lines connect J1 directly to ESP32-WROOM-32 USB_D+/USB_D-; the WROOM module has no native USB PHY, so a USB-UART bridge is likely required.
Manufacturing limited to generic_two_layer: 2 layers, no blind/buried vias, no via-in-pad, minimum 0.2 mm trace/clearance.
Board must fit within the existing 110 x 65 mm outline (35,35 to 145,100).
ESP32 module antenna region must remain free of copper and components.
No cost ceiling, quantity, or environmental/certification target was supplied in the specification; these remain open items.

power.input: USB-C VBUS, 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V); on-board regulator to 3.3 V required (currently absent from the netlist)

requirements.statement: The board shall be powered from a USB-C receptacle supplying VBUS at 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V per USB 2.0 tolerance).

requirements.source: net list: +3V3 only reaches U1.1, U1.8; no regulator present
requirements.statement: A regulator shall derive a 3.3 V logic rail from VBUS to supply U1 (ESP32-WROOM-32) and U2 (TMP102); the +3V3 net currently has no source.
The 3.3 V rail shall supply at least 600 mA continuous to cover ESP32 Wi-Fi transmit peaks plus sensor load.
VBUS input shall be limited to 500 mA maximum draw from the USB host.

requirements.source: pin table: U2.1 VCC absent from all nets
requirements.statement: U2 (TMP102) VCC shall be connected to the +3V3 rail; it is currently unconnected.

requirements.source: net list: GND = J1.4, U1.2, U2.5
requirements.statement: U2 (TMP102) GND pin 2 shall be connected to the GND net; only U2.5 (ADD0) is currently on GND.
Each power pin of U1 and U2 shall have local decoupling: 100 nF per pin plus a 10 uF bulk capacitor per rail.
Exactly one PWR_FLAG shall be attached per power net (+3V3, GND, VBUS) to satisfy ERC power-source checks.

requirements.source: request: 'I2C sensor'; pin table shows GPIO21/22 and U2.3/U2.4 unconnected
requirements.statement: The board shall provide one I2C bus at 3.3 V logic connecting U1.GPIO21 (SDA) to U2.SDA and U1.GPIO22 (SCL) to U2.SCL; neither net exists today.
SDA and SCL shall each be pulled up to +3V3 with 4.7 kOhm resistors for 100 kHz standard-mode operation.
I2C clock rate shall be 100 kHz minimum capability, up to 400 kHz fast mode supported by TMP102.

requirements.source: net list: GND includes U2.5 ADD0
requirements.statement: U2.ADD0 shall be strapped to a defined logic level to select the I2C slave address; it is currently tied to GND, which must be an intentional address selection rather than an accidental connection.

requirements.source: request specifies USB-C; J1 lib_id is Connector:USB_B_Micro
requirements.statement: The USB interface shall use a USB-C receptacle with CC1/CC2 5.1 kOhm pulldowns for sink advertisement, replacing the currently specified USB_B_Micro connector J1.
USB data pair D+/D- shall be routed as a 90 Ohm differential pair between J1 and the USB transceiver, matched within 5 mm.

requirements.source: net list: +3V3 = U1.1, U1.8 (EN directly on rail)
requirements.statement: The ESP32 EN pin shall have a reset circuit (10 kOhm pullup to +3V3 and 100 nF to GND) rather than being tied directly to the +3V3 net.
Digital I/O signal levels shall be 3.3 V CMOS for all logic interfaces (I2C, GPIO25, EN).
Board outline shall not exceed 110 mm width.
Board outline shall not exceed 65 mm height.
The PCB shall be a 2-layer design.
The USB-C connector shall be placed on a board edge with its mating face flush to the outline for cable access.
The ESP32 module antenna keep-out shall extend beyond or overhang the board edge with no copper, planes, or components beneath it.
The temperature sensor U2 shall be placed at least 15 mm from the regulator and ESP32 module to reduce self-heating error.
All components shall be placed within the outline with a minimum 1 mm courtyard-to-edge clearance.
Minimum trace width shall be 0.2 mm and minimum copper clearance 0.2 mm for the generic_two_layer process.
Minimum via shall be 0.6 mm pad with 0.3 mm drill.

requirements.source: IPC-2221 current capacity, derived from PWR-003
requirements.statement: Power traces carrying up to 600 mA shall be at least 0.5 mm wide on 1 oz copper.
The design shall release a complete fabrication package: Gerbers, drill files, IPC-356 netlist, BOM, and centroid file.
All parts shall use standard two-layer-compatible footprints with no blind/buried vias, no via-in-pad, and no controlled impedance stackup requirement beyond MFG-001.

requirements.source: project spec: constraints = [] (no cost target given)
requirements.statement: The bill of materials shall be minimized by reusing a single passive value set; no cost ceiling was specified in the request, so cost is tracked but unconstrained pending stakeholder input.
All components shall be commercially available in single-piece quantities from at least two distributors to avoid sole-source cost risk.
The board shall operate over an ambient range of 0 C to 70 C (commercial), bounded by the narrowest device rating.
Measured temperature accuracy shall be within +/-1.0 C over 0 C to 60 C, including board self-heating error.
Regulator junction temperature rise shall stay below 40 C above ambient at maximum load.
ERC shall report 0 errors, improving on the baseline of 10 errors and 8 warnings; remaining warnings shall be individually justified.
DRC shall report 0 errors, improving on the baseline of 5 errors and 13 warnings; remaining warnings shall be individually justified.

requirements.source: pin table vs net list comparison
requirements.statement: There shall be zero unconnected pins in the netlist; the currently floating pins U1.3, U1.4, U1.5, U2.1, U2.2, U2.3, U2.4 and net VBUS (single node J1.1) shall be resolved or explicitly marked no-connect.
Powering the board from a USB-C host shall produce 3.3 V +/-5% on the +3V3 rail measured at U1.1 and U2.1.
An I2C bus scan shall detect the TMP102 at its strapped address and return plausible ambient readings within TEMP-002 accuracy.
Board dimensions extracted from fabrication output shall be 110 x 65 mm or smaller with a 2-layer stackup.
